documents.title: IoT Architecture Basics
documents.content: The Internet of Things (IoT) consists of connected devices. An IoT gateway is part of an IoT architecture. A temperature sensor measures temperature. A humidity sensor measures humidity. Each IoT device uses MQTT. MQTT is a lightweight messaging protocol designed for constrained devices.

documents.title: Edge Computing and Sensors
documents.content: Edge computing reduces network latency for IoT applications. Temperature sensors measure temperature in smart buildings. Zigbee is an alternative to Wi-Fi for low-power networks. Sensor data is encrypted with AES before transmission.
